Package com.example.ecolums

Class Leaderboard

java.lang.Object
com.example.ecolums.Leaderboard
public class Leaderboard extends Object
Retrieves, ranks, and exposes leaderboard data for individual users and clubs across all-time and weekly timeframes.

Responsibilities (from CRC card):

  • Maintain real-time leaderboard ranking.
  • Retrieve total scores for all Users/Clubs.
  • Rank entities based on points.
  • Identify top performers for badge awards.
  • Filter rankings by categories.
  • Support rankings and standings for sustainability challenges and competitions.

Collaborators: User, ProgressTracker.

Reads from the users and clubs Firestore collections. Rankings are re-derived on demand (at most once per 24 h for the all-time board) rather than stored in a separate collection, to keep data consistent.

Outstanding issues: Real-time listener for the weekly board updates has not been attached to the UI fragment. Pagination not yet implemented — the board currently loads all users, which will not scale.

  • Method Details

    • getUserRankings

      public void getUserRankings(String timeframe, Leaderboard.OnRankingsLoadedCallback callback)
      Fetches and ranks all users by their total green points.

      For TIMEFRAME_ALL_TIME, reads totalPoints directly from each user document. For TIMEFRAME_WEEKLY, queries each user's activityLogs for the current week and sums pointsEarned.

      Results are ordered highest-to-lowest and each entry is assigned a rank number (1-indexed).

      Parameters:
      timeframe - One of TIMEFRAME_ALL_TIME or TIMEFRAME_WEEKLY.
      callback - Receives the ordered list of Leaderboard.RankEntry objects.

    • getUserRank

      public void getUserRank(String userId, String timeframe, Leaderboard.OnSingleRankCallback callback)
      Returns the rank and score of a specific user within the given timeframe.

      Uses the cached rankings if available; otherwise triggers a fresh getUserRankings(java.lang.String, com.example.ecolums.Leaderboard.OnRankingsLoadedCallback) call.

      Parameters:
      userId - UID of the user to look up.
      timeframe - One of TIMEFRAME_ALL_TIME or TIMEFRAME_WEEKLY.
      callback - Receives the user's Leaderboard.RankEntry, or null if not found.

    • getClubRankings

      public void getClubRankings(Leaderboard.OnRankingsLoadedCallback callback)
      Fetches and ranks all clubs by their aggregated totalPoints.

      Reads the totalPoints field from each document in the clubs collection, sorts descending, and assigns rank numbers.

      Parameters:
      callback - Receives the ordered list of club Leaderboard.RankEntry objects.

    • getChallengeRankings

      public void getChallengeRankings(String challengeId, Leaderboard.OnRankingsLoadedCallback callback)
      Returns a ranked leaderboard for a specific challenge.

      Reads participantScores from the challenge document and sorts entries by score descending. Applies per-capita averaging if the participants are clubs rather than individuals, to ensure fair competition between groups of different sizes.

      Parameters:
      challengeId - Firestore document ID of the challenge.
      callback - Receives the ordered list of challenge Leaderboard.RankEntry objects.

    • getTopPerformers

      public void getTopPerformers(String entityType, String timeframe, int topN, Leaderboard.OnRankingsLoadedCallback callback)
      Returns the top N users or clubs by score within a given timeframe.

      Used by AdminDashboard for reports and by ProgressTracker when concluding challenges to identify badge recipients.

      Parameters:
      entityType - One of ENTITY_USER or ENTITY_CLUB.
      timeframe - One of TIMEFRAME_ALL_TIME or TIMEFRAME_WEEKLY.
      topN - How many top entries to return.
      callback - Receives the top-N list.
